chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from the one who mentioned it, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Indeed, it was revealed: 'Then as to those whom you enjoy with,' (referring to temporary marriage).
give them their dowries as appointed.

key_terms.فَمَا اسْتَمْتَعْتُمْ بِهِ: Those whom you enjoy with (referring to temporary wives)

ai.seo_question: What is the Quranic basis for the dowry in temporary marriage (Mut'ah) according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) elucidates that the phrase 'those whom you enjoy with' in Surah An-Nisa specifically validates the institution of Mut'ah by linking it to the mandatory payment of dowry (ujrah). This narration is pivotal in Shia jurisprudence for affirming the validity of temporary marriage, distinguishing it from permanent marriage by emphasizing the contractual nature of the compensation as a fixed due rather than a discretionary gift.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from the one who mentioned it, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘But rather, it (Mut’a) was Revealed
[4:24] Then as to those whom you enjoy with,
give them their dowries as appointed’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from those whom he has mentioned who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
It was revealed as “If you marry them [for an appointed time] for al-Mut‘ah (advantageous marriage) you must pay their dowries.”
